# Daminion

> Daminion is a comprehensive Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform offering both on-premise and cloud-based solutions with AI-powered tagging, advanced search, and enterprise-grade security for organizing and managing digital assets.

Daminion serves organizations across multiple industries including creative agencies, media production, architecture, and higher education. The platform integrates with Adobe Creative Cloud, supports various metadata standards (EXIF, IPTC, XMP), and deploys on enterprise infrastructure including Synology, QNAP, NetApp, and cloud providers like AWS, Azure, and GCP.

## Key Topics

- Digital Asset Management (DAM)
- AI Tagging & Facial Recognition
- On-Premise Deployment
- Cloud Storage Solutions
- Adobe Creative Cloud Integration
- Metadata Standards (EXIF, IPTC, XMP)
- Enterprise Security & GDPR Compliance
- NAS Servers (Synology, QNAP, NetApp)
- Advanced Search & Indexing
- Team Collaboration & Access Control
- 3D Asset Management
- Version Control
- GPS/Location-Based Organization
- Media Production Workflows
- Secure Digital Storage

## Core DAM Solutions

- [Digital Asset Management (DAM) Software | Daminion](https://daminion.net/digital-asset-management): Core DAM software overview covering organization, search, and team workflows
- [Cloud Digital Asset Management | Daminion Cloud](https://daminion.net/cloud-dam): Cloud-based DAM with AI tagging, collaboration, and AWS/Azure/GCP hosting
- [On-Premise DAM Software | Secure Local Asset Management](https://daminion.net/on-prem-dam): On-premise DAM solution with local storage on Synology, QNAP, NetApp servers
- [Daminion Features | Digital Asset Management Capabilities](https://daminion.net/features): Feature overview: AI tagging, search, metadata, version control, collaboration

## AI & Search Capabilities

- [AI Photo and Image Tagging for Digital Asset Management](https://daminion.net/features/ai-tagging): AI-powered automatic tagging with facial recognition and duplicate detection
- [Enhanced Digital Asset Search | Find Files Fast with Daminion DAM](https://daminion.net/features/advanced-search-in-dam): Advanced AI search with metadata indexing using EXIF, IPTC, XMP standards
- [Facial Recognition Photo Management | Daminion DAM](https://daminion.net/features/facial-recognition): Facial recognition for organizing and tagging people across photo libraries

## Enterprise Features & Security

- [Secure Digital Asset Storage | On-Premise DAM by Daminion](https://daminion.net/features/secure-digital-asset-management): Security-focused on-premise storage with GDPR compliance and access control
- [3D Digital Asset Management Software](https://daminion.net/features/3d-asset-management): 3D model management with preview, version control for Blender, 3ds Max, Cinema 4D
- [Daminion Integrations | Connect Creative Tools & Workflows](https://daminion.net/integrations): Adobe Creative Cloud integration with Photoshop, InDesign, and workflow automation

## Industry-Specific Solutions

- [Digital Asset Management for Creative Agencies](https://daminion.net/industries/creative-agencies): Creative agency solution for client assets, campaigns, and design files
- [Digital Asset Management for Media Production](https://daminion.net/industries/media-production): Media production DAM for video, audio, and large imagery collections
- [Digital Asset Management for Architecture Firms](https://daminion.net/industries/architecture): Architecture-specific DAM for presentations, renderings, and project portfolios
- [Digital Asset Management for Construction Firms](https://daminion.net/industries/construction): Construction industry solution for site photos and project archive management
- [Digital Asset Management for Higher Education & Research](https://daminion.net/industries/higher-education): Academic DAM for research visuals, publications, and institutional archives

## Workflow Solutions

- [Design and Content Production Asset Management](https://daminion.net/workflows/design-and-production): Design workflow with Adobe integration, version control, and collaboration
- [Marketing Asset Management Software](https://daminion.net/workflows/marketing): Marketing workflow solution for campaign asset organization and secure sharing
- [Location-Based Digital Asset Management Software](https://daminion.net/workflows/location-based-asset-management): Geotagged asset management with GPS metadata and map-based search
- [Digital Asset Management for Sales and Proposal Content](https://daminion.net/workflows/sales-and-proposal-management): Sales asset management for proposal generation and client content sharing
